name: Bully
overview: Scripture reveals that bullies are characterized by deceit, mischief, and a heart inclined toward iniquity and destruction, as seen in Psalms 10:7 and Isaiah 59:7. The Lord commands His people to be strong and courageous, trusting in His presence amid opposition (Joshua 1:9). While believers may face false accusations and revilement for Christ’s sake, they are called to respond without judgment toward others (Matthew 5:11; 7:1), knowing that God will ultimately bring down the scorner and those who delight in evil (Isaiah 29:20).
